info.name: Oracle Multicloud Omhub Network Anchor API

params.name: compartmentId
params.description:
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Multicloud base compartment or sub-compartment in which to list resources.
A Multicloud base compartment is an OCI compartment that maps to a subscription in a cloud service provider (such as Azure or AWS).

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Multicloud subscription in which to list resources.

params.name: subscriptionServiceName
params.description: The cloud service provider.

params.name: networkAnchorLifecycleState
params.description:
A filter to return only resources that match the given lifecycle state. The
state value is case-insensitive.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given display name exactly.

params.name: externalLocation
params.description: The cloud service provider region.

params.name: networkAnchorOciSubnetId
params.description: A filter to return only NetworkAnchor resources that match the given OCI subnet Id.

params.name: compartmentIdInSubtree
params.description: If set to true, a list operation will return NetworkAnchors from all child compartments in the provided compartmentId parameter.

params.name: networkAnchorOciVcnId
params.description: A filter to return only NetworkAnchor resources that match the given OCI Vcn Id.

params.name: id
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the NetworkAnchor.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous
"List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: shouldFetchVcnName
params.description: Whether to fetch and include the vcn display name, which may introduce additional latency.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description:
The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).
In general, the sort order is `DESC` when sorting by time and `ASC` otherwise.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. You can provide only one sort order. Default order for `timeCreated`
is descending. Default order for `displayName` is ascending.

items.docs:
Lists network anchors in the specified Multicloud subscription, Multicloud compartment, and partner cloud region.
Details listed for each resource include name, state, VCN, and ODB network ID.
For more information, see
[Listing Network Anchors](/iaas/Content/multicloud-hub/list-network-anchors.htm).

params.name: networkAnchorId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the NetworkAnchor.

params.name: subscriptionServiceName
params.description: The cloud service provider.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Multicloud subscription in which to list resources.

params.name: externalLocation
params.description: The cloud service provider region.

params.name: shouldFetchVcnName
params.description: Whether to fetch and include the vcn display name, which may introduce additional latency.

items.docs:
Gets details for the specified network anchor. The subscription OCID and service name are required.
For more information, see
[Getting a Network Anchor's Details](/iaas/Content/multicloud-hub/get-network-anchor.htm).
